text: 2026-09-22 owner decision (facade middle path): the facade no longer waits on compatibility bd-01M2WVFV2WGF5BVQHX7JTYYWRH; it now depends directly on reference bd-01M2WVF86T8QEEA1TK8Z0ASJHW (and still on reconstruction bd-01M2TAD04SR823TQVG9VPNH6R3 and timing). It publishes BOTH mappings side by side for every run: the local reference mapping (per-unit evidence, no order/neighbour assumptions) and the named structured reconstruction, each labelled with its stage provenance, so a user can see where structural assumptions changed the answer. Organization/order readouts are NOT offered by the facade until compatibility lands (refusal by absence, not by labels). Owner: 'reference and reconstruction are both important'. A tunable weight between them is filed separately.
